description:
Trace the incredible rise and fall of the Ottoman Empire, exploring how a small frontier principality grew into a superpower spanning three continents.

Discover the hidden turning points that shaped global history, from the conquest of Constantinople and the reign of Suleiman the Magnificent to the challenges of modernization and the birth of the modern Republic of Turkey.
